entries.what: Marcus clocked in at Ridgeline RF-4 at 10 p.m. and found José's board posting him to the cold dock, so he borrowed a freezer jacket for the night.
entries.outcome: Spent the shift picking in the freezer area with numb fingers and stayed on rate.

entries.what: Earlier that day he made the 2 p.m. section on the Bayshore campus and then ate Sunday-prep chicken and rice at the apartment before the shift.
entries.outcome: Got through class without nodding off.

entries.what: His mom Denise's drugstore hours officially dropped to 24 a week, and she called Marcus to say she was managing fine.
entries.outcome: He said little but started worrying about her rent and bills.

entries.what: After shift Marcus ate eggs and rice and slept from 8 a.m. until 1 p.m. in unit 132 while Arjun left for the train.
entries.outcome: Got a full sleep block and woke up stiff from the cold dock.

entries.what: Back at Ridgeline for the night shift, Marcus worked the cold dock again and carpooled nothing, biking in. Trevor griped about rate scanners beeping red.
entries.outcome: Finished the shift with no write-up.

entries.what: Marcus got off shift at 6:30 a.m., slept until 1 p.m., then rode the Tule Line to Bayshore for his 2 p.m. section and borrowed Fatima's Google Doc notes for the lecture he missed.
entries.outcome: Caught up on Ex Phys notes.

entries.what: Sunday-through-Thursday night shift on the cold dock; he wore the freezer jacket and listened to old-school West Coast rap in one earbud.
entries.outcome: Hit rate and clocked out on time.

entries.what: Marcus sat through the Thursday afternoon section half-awake and then grabbed a quick dinner before shift.
entries.outcome: Took scrappy notes and planned to compare with Fatima's.

entries.what: At work Trevor got another rate warning and confirmed he is on final warning, which made Marcus pay closer attention to his own scanner.
entries.outcome: Marcus stayed above rate and tucked the lesson away.

entries.what: Marcus texted Jade a short good-night message from the breakroom, and she replied that she wanted to see him on her day off.
entries.outcome: He agreed to Saturday and promised to stay awake.

entries.what: It was payday and Marcus went through his monthly budget, trimmed his gym supplements, and found room for $150 to send to his mom.
entries.outcome: Budget redone with the mom fund line added.

entries.what: He sent Denise $150 by Venmo; she texted back that it was a loan and she was writing it in her notebook.
entries.outcome: The first mom-fund transfer went through and she accepted it as a loan.

entries.what: Marcus got a Taquería Colima burrito after the shift paycheck cleared, then ate and slept through the morning.
entries.outcome: Treated himself cheaply and crashed by 8:30.

entries.what: Arjun mentioned that Omar had landed a summer internship, and Marcus teased him about it while they ate dinner.
entries.outcome: Arjun went quiet and went back to his resume.

entries.what: Marcus did his Saturday-morning lift at Iron Flats after shift, working with Mike on the 5/3/1 program.
entries.outcome: Felt strong on deadlifts despite the sleep debt.

entries.what: He slept until the afternoon, then walked Calle Ortega with Jade through the street fair, eating from stalls and listening to live music.
entries.outcome: A good afternoon together without any tension.

entries.what: They ended the evening with a bowl of pho at Phở Bến Thành after the fair crowds thinned.
entries.outcome: Jade said she appreciated him showing up.

entries.what: Marcus did his Sunday chicken-and-rice meal prep, five containers, before his night shift.
entries.outcome: Fridge stocked for the week.

entries.what: Arjun left the printed grocery list on the counter and Marcus ignored it while he cooked.
entries.outcome: No argument, just a long look.

entries.what: He biked to Ridgeline for his 10 p.m. start and worked another cold dock night.
entries.outcome: Ended the week on rate.
